scope: face-coordinate method foundation only; no source-coordinate or physical-problem change

mathematics.forward: eta = sum_j ((w_j * L_j) / normalization) * tanh(u_j), with nonpivot sum then pivot addition
mathematics.inverse: tanh(u_p) = (eta - sum_{j != p} a_j * tanh(u_j)) / a_p; u_p = atanh(tanh(u_p)) only for strict fraction in (-1,1)
mathematics.finite_domain: fixed products, normalized row and absolute bound must be finite; finite pivot scale must be positive
mathematics.fp64_domain_guard: nonzero pivot contribution must exceed 64*eps times the sum of absolute nonpivot contributions; recovered latent must satisfy a 64*eps-scaled roundtrip tolerance
mathematics.metric_and_limits: normalized signed face-flux metric; FP64 reduction order may differ; conservative guard can reject a control that this particular reduction order could roundtrip; no event or branch certificate
mathematics.hessian_chain: J.T @ H @ J + sum_i g_i * Hess(c_i); transformed Hessian may be indefinite away from an original stationary point
mathematics.physical_gate: original physical full-gradient 1e-10 gate remains authoritative

calls: analytical toy objective for chart JVP/VJP/Hessian chain checks
